headline: How the Moonwatch Passed NASA
stop_reason: Stopped. Only the NASA 1 March 1965 certification and the 11 trials are double-sourced (T3 and Swatch Group press). The Apollo and Gemini beats are single-outlet (T3), so they cannot be published as facts. Cutting them leaves too few verified beats for a 7-9 slide story, and the Speedmaster has only 2 exact-reference photos in the library. Needs a second independent source for the Apollo history, or a different story.
